references.text: The same principle regarding unintentional sin committed by the whole congregation, with similar sacrificial regulations for the sin offering
Prescribes that the congregation must offer a bull as a sin offering when the sin is discovered
Regulations for burnt offerings from cattle that produce a pleasing aroma to the Lord
Regulations for grain offerings that were to accompany the burnt offering
Earlier in the same chapter concerning grain offerings and drink offerings to accompany the burnt offering
A similar combination of burnt offering, grain offering, drink offering, and sin offering with a male goat
Male goat as a sin offering to the Lord in addition to the daily burnt offering
Sacrifice of male goats as a sin offering for all Israel after returning from exile
Refers to sin offerings for unintentional sins in the sacrificial service of the old covenant
